blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Emilio Aguinaldo College made history on Tuesday night, finally breaking through to the NCAA Final Four for the first time in school history. The Generals dominated College of St. Benilde, 88-64, in the Season 102 quarterfinals at San Juan Arena to secure their first-ever semifinal berth in the league. Since joining the Grand Old League in 2009, EAC had never sniffed a Final Four appearance. When the Generals finally achieved that feat, team veteran Jude Bagay took the microphone to pay tribute to the players who helped build the program. “I’m very happy, but this win isn’t for me alone,” […]...
